text.*:
Installing character types varies from type to type, but it generally follows this pattern.

  1. Shutdown your server
  2. Download the character type's jar into your plugins folder
  3. Start up your server, then shut it down again
  4. Edit any necessary configuration files for that character type
  5. Turn the server back on
  6. ???
  7. Profit.

See the individual character's wiki page for specific details on that type's installation.
